remarks:
Beautifully Updated Home on Nearly an Acre – Minutes from the Village of East Aurora

Nestled on a beautifully landscaped 0.86-acre corner lot within the highly regarded East Aurora School District, this exceptional 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of privacy, modern updates, and everyday comfort. Beautifully updated and meticulously maintained, this move-in-ready home offers timeless style, modern comfort, and pride of ownership throughout.

A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into a bright and inviting living room highlighted by soaring cathedral ceilings and a warm gas fireplace. The spacious eat-in kitchen is designed to be the heart of the home, featuring quality cabinetry, granite countertops, a breakfast bar, and an abundance of natural light overlooking the peaceful backyard.

Whether you're hosting holiday dinners in the formal dining room or enjoying summer evenings on the expansive stamped concrete patio with its custom fire pit, this home is designed for gathering with family and friends. The private backyard offers plenty of room to relax, entertain, or simply enjoy the peaceful setting.

Upstairs, all three bedrooms feature new carpeting, including a spacious primary suite with a tray ceiling, generous closet space, and a beautifully renovated ensuite bath with a walk-in glass shower. Updated bathrooms, a thoughtfully designed laundry room with exceptional storage, and a partially finished basement provide the flexibility today's buyers are looking for.

Additional highlights include central air, a newer furnace, an attached two-car garage, storage shed, and meticulous landscaping that enhances the home's outstanding curb appeal.

Perfectly positioned just minutes from the charming Village of East Aurora, you'll enjoy award-winning restaurants, boutique shopping, parks, golf courses, and year-round community events—all while benefiting from the sought-after East Aurora School District. Offering the ideal combination of quality, location, and lifestyle, this is a home you'll be proud to call your own.
